escalate.instructions: A line has decided it cannot go on alone. `nova-decide help --state` has already answered continue, ask-all-friends or ask-glenn from the line's own counters, and that answer is in the state as help_answer; this question is the SECOND half of it -- to WHOM. The criteria below are the whole rule and docs/decide/criteria-escalate.md is their long form, which the asker embeds in the state. Never answer glenn where help_answer is ask-all-friends: a line that has not asked its friends has not earned the interrupt.

criteria.johnny: security_shaped_package=yes, or what is stuck is a guard, a secret, the sandbox, sudo, deploy keys, the network, the reaper, the launcher or the merge machinery. At any height, at any floor, before any other answer.
criteria.stella: spec_is_silent_or_contradictory=yes, or the stuck thing is a design default no ruling covers, kernel semantics, or scope. Measured 2026-09-19: work-swarm escalated E05.6 as not cuttable at 17:22Z, Stella ruled on both defaults, and the row landed in one card on the bottom rung 90 minutes later.
criteria.emma: Go correctness, tests, or a document checked against what a binary prints, inside a lane Emma owns. friend_holds_the_area=emma is a strong pull to this answer.
criteria.all-friends: help_answer is ask-all-friends and no single friend owns the question: it crosses lanes, or two friends' rulings would have to agree.
criteria.rowan: is_a_landing_order_question=yes: sequencing, which branch goes first, whether to keep a card in flight. The coordinator holds the shift's context and no friend does.
criteria.glenn: ONLY where help_answer is ask-glenn -- the friends have been asked and it is still open -- and the question is one no friend may rule: a rule of the fleet, a spend, a licence, or a contradiction between two of his own instructions.
